text:
alex: Heads up — p99 latency spiked on hosted-api at ~03:12 UTC, looks correlated with a big regen of KV/prefix cache entries. Anyone on call?

sre-bot: Incident created: INC-1821 — KV cache churn / latency spike (auto-detected). Paging eng-runtime.

nina: I can see eviction rate on node-gpu-7 jump ~03:10 — `kv_prefix_evictions_total` +100k in 5m. prefix_ttl_resets spiked too.

maria: Did we roll anything early morning? I deployed the batching-policy change last night (batch_timeout 40ms) but also there was a config push to cache params around 02:49.

kai: grabbing a quick profile — looks like eviction comparator hot in samples, lots of time in `prefix_cmp()` and `insert_or_evict()`. Running: `perf record -F 99 -p $(pgrep runtime) -- sleep 30 && flamegraph.pl perf.data > fg.svg`

alex: snippet from logs: ```2026-03-17T03:11:58Z runtime[pid=3242]: Evicting prefix="q1/long/seq/…" len=512 reason=ttl_expired freed=480``` lots of similar lines. hit_rate.go shows prefix_hit_rate drop 92% -> 14% in 3m.

nina: hypothesis: noisy neighbor + smaller max_prefix_entries caused large prefixes to be treated as cold, eviction loop: big prefixes evicted then reinserted by concurrent requests, causing churn and comparator pressure.

maria: found the config diff: `max_prefix_entries: 20000 -> 5000` in deploy at 2026-03-17 02:49 (infra-config repo). That plus batcher timeout increase increases KV write bursts.

kai: repro quick: bombard model with long-context requests: 
```
for i in {1..2000}; do 
  curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY" -d '{"input":"<long prefix>...","max_tokens":1}' https://api.redwood.test/generate > /dev/null &
done
```
watching `prefix_hitrate` metric: drops from 0.92 -> 0.12 within 90s.

alex: mitigation applied: reverted `max_prefix_entries` to 20k and rolled back the infra-config change (deploy-bot did the revert), plus pushed a temporary fix to eviction comparator to prefer evicting smallest prefixes first (PR 2304). Canary on west-1 dedicated pool started.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed: infra-config@main reverted (commit f1a2b3). Canary started on pool=dedicated-west-1.

nina: after revert, eviction rate normalized within ~6 minutes and p99 returned to baseline. Monitoring shows prefix_hit_rate back to ~90%.

maria: follow-ups: add unit test for partial-restore path that was missing, add a stress test that ramps prefix churn, and add an alert that triggers on sustained prefix_ttl_resets > 10k/min. I'll open tickets.

kai: also adding a microbenchmark for comparator choices (small-first vs oldest-first) — will PR to eng-runtime tests.

alex: agree — postmortem please. Key action items: revert safeguards for config pushes (require canary), hard limit tests in CI, and add presubmit lint to flag big cache param changes.

sre-bot: Incident INC-1821 resolved by alex, nina, maria, kai. Duration 47m.

maria: created issue: https://redwood.internal/issue/RI-5698 - assigning eng-runtime + eng-ml.

nina: thanks everyone :raised_hands: — logging this for the perf retro.
